description.en:
Empties the match's forced-win list: all 32 entries added with CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN are cleared at once, whichever form was used to add them. The forced-lose list is not touched (see CMND_BTL_RESET_FORCE_LOSE).
The story matches call both resets in their result callback.

examples.case: Cleaning up in the result callback (real usage, from btl0003.nut)
